entries.a4543bcf884eca55: Among companies with revenue of ¥10 billion or more 5 periods ago, the largest growth was [[company:financial-partners-group|FPG]], at 8.69 times.
entries.a707db276ee90e27: Of the listed companies, 2,903 companies had revenue for all 5 periods. For each company, calculating "revenue in the latest period ÷ revenue 5 periods ago" (a calculated value), the median was 1.26 times, with 2,489 companies (85.7%) growing and 414 companies (14.3%) shrinking. Because the starting period includes, for many companies, a period when revenue slumped during the COVID pandemic, the growth also includes recovery from the slump.
entries.a76499186966a7fa: Revenue growth over 5 periods by industry (median)
entries.adec609ad750aaff: By industry median, the largest growth was [[industry:entertainment|Entertainment]] (1.58 times), followed by Finance, IT & Software, and Real Estate. Even [[industry:media|Media]], the smallest, was 1.13 times, and there was no industry whose median was below 1.00 times. In other words, over these 5 periods there was no "shrinking industry," and shrinkage is occurring company by company, not industry by industry.
